nodes.title: Card Overview
widgets_values: A photorealistic character and wardrobe reference board containing exactly FOUR separate pictures in one horizontal row on a light-gray background. From LEFT to RIGHT: (1) one close frontal portrait showing the complete head, hair and shoulders; (2) one neckless FRONT body-proportion reference with visible unclothed anatomical outline, bare feet; (3) one neckless FRONT view of the selected outfit; (4) one neckless BACK view of the same selected outfit. All four pictures depict the same young adult woman, age 25, with the same slim adult female body proportions and matching skin tone. The three body displays have the same shoulder width, waist width, hip width and limb lengths, at the same shoulder-to-ankle scale. Each picture is fully contained in its own bounding box, with empty background above its highest point and below the feet. The two clothed outfit views retain their stockings and high heels; only the second panel is the neutral anatomical proportion study. Soft even studio light, natural fabric and skin texture.

nodes.title: Portrait Description
widgets_values: A straight-on studio headshot photographed with the camera centered at eye level. Her head is upright and centered, with the nose-to-chin axis vertical and both eyes on a horizontal line. Her face and torso point directly toward the camera, her shoulders are level and square to the camera, and her gaze looks straight into the lens. A close photographic portrait of a young adult woman with a softly oval face, dark almond-shaped eyes, a small straight nose, natural rosy lips and smooth natural skin with subtle visible texture. Her black hair is pinned into a loose elegant updo with fine strands beside her cheeks and one dark-red flower ornament. She has a calm, relaxed expression while keeping this straight-on posture. Include the complete head and hair with background above, shoulders and upper chest; the portrait ends at the upper chest. Her clothing at the shoulders and upper chest is {{outfit_portrait}} Keep the same close headshot framing, with the complete head, hair and shoulders visible.

widgets_values: A neckless FRONT ghost-mannequin fashion display of this person's outfit and body proportions. The head and entire neck are invisible. The garment collar is the highest part of the figure, with an empty hollow neckline and clear gray background above it. The whole figure is contained within its panel. The body belongs to the same young adult woman in the portrait, with slim adult female proportions and matching visible skin. Both arms hang naturally at the sides, with separate visible hands. Both feet and complete shoes fit inside the region with space below. She wears {{outfit}} Keep the complete body and shoes inside the region, with visible gray margins above the garment collar and below the soles. The body ends at the garment neckline; no head, throat or neck stump extends above it. Do not replace this empty space with a cropped head outside the panel.

widgets_values: A neutral, nonsexual anatomical proportion study: a neckless straight-on FRONT view of the same 25-year-old adult woman shown in the portrait and the two clothed outfit panels. Her head and entire neck are invisible, with clear gray background above the complete shoulder silhouette. She has the same slim adult female proportions, shoulder width, waist width, hip width and limb lengths as both clothing views, with matching skin tone. She stands upright and square to the camera in a symmetrical relaxed measurement stance, arms slightly separated from the torso, open relaxed hands, straight legs and feet slightly apart. The figure has an unclothed body outline. The shoulders, torso, abdomen, waist, hips, arms, hands, thighs, knees, lower legs and bare feet remain visible for body proportion reference. No clothing, stockings, footwear or accessories on this anatomical study. The complete figure, both hands and all toes fit within this panel with clear empty space above and below. Neutral reference photography with soft even studio light.
